Full skill text at 5★
At the beginning of each wave and the owner's turn, grants all allies a [Shield] by 60% of the owner's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer. Besides, grants all allies [Hallowed Protection] (reduces DMG taken by 24%) for 1 turn, up to 1 layer. Each time after an ally takes DMG from basic attacks or active skills, the owner will grant the ally [Indomitable Spirit] (increases Tenacity by 80%) and [Sacred Immortality] (increases Mastery RES by 80%) for 2 turns. This effect can only be triggered again after each ally's turn starts. Upgrades the inflicted [Shield] to [Hallow Crystal Shield], cannot be stolen or removed.
Full skill text at 7★
At the beginning of each wave and the owner's turn, grants all allies a [Shield] by 60% of the owner's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer. Besides, grants all allies [Hallowed Protection] (reduces DMG taken by 30%) for 1 turn, up to 1 layer. Each time after an ally takes DMG from basic attacks or active skills, the owner will grant the ally [Indomitable Spirit] (increases Tenacity by 100%) and [Sacred Immortality] (increases Mastery RES by 100%) for 2 turns. This effect can only be triggered again after each ally's turn starts. Upgrades the inflicted [Shield] to [Hallow Crystal Shield], cannot be stolen or removed. If the owner is a Defender, restores the ally's HP by 20% of the owner's Max HP after they grant any ally [Shield]. At the beginning of the owner's turn, revives a dead ally with 30% HP. The effect will enter a 4-turn CD after being triggered. Only 1 of the effects takes effect if the same effects exist.
Source: game files.

Effects

  • [Shield] — Blocks some DMG.
  • [Hallowed Protection] — Reduces DMG taken by a certain amount.
  • [Indomitable Spirit] — Increases Tenacity by a certain amount.
  • [Hallow Crystal Shield] — [Hallow Crystal Shield] cannot be stolen or removed.
